name: GreenTech Environmental pureAir FRIDGE Refrigerator Air Purifier & Odor Eliminator
description: Keep your groceries fresher for up to 3x longer and banish stubborn odors with this super compact GreenTech pureAir FRIDGE air purifier! It utilizes advanced active ionization and activated oxygen (ozone) technology to neutralize bacteria (like E-coli) and decay-producing ethylene gas right inside your refrigerator. It features an intelligent photosensor and an auditory/visual LED alert to let you know when the long-lasting lithium battery needs a charge via standard Micro-USB. Note: The unit has some very minor cosmetic micro-scratches on the glossy white shell from normal shelf placement, which do not impact its operation at all. Coming from a pet-friendly student home with a resident cat, the exterior has been completely sanitized with isopropyl alcohol wipes and blast-cleaned with compressed air before listing.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and ready to drop into your refrigerator door pocket or shelf immediately. Bring a small bag if picking up locally. Completely cat-friendly disclosure: while thoroughly sanitized with alcohol, it comes from a home with a cat.
meta_description: Shop the GreenTech Environmental pureAir FRIDGE refrigerator air purifier and odor eliminator. Compact active ionization tech to keep groceries fresh.
name_zh: GreenTech pureAir 冰箱活性氧迷你除臭空气净化器
description_zh: 极力推荐这款宝藏 GreenTech pureAir 冰箱专属空气净化器！采用主动离子与低浓度活性氧（臭氧）双重净化技术，能有效降解引发食物腐烂的乙烯气体并抑制细菌繁殖，让冷藏室内的水果蔬菜保鲜期延长高达3倍，彻底告别剩菜串味或异味。内置光感智能系统，冰箱门打开时如果电量低会有蜂鸣与LED灯贴心提醒，使用普通Micro-USB充电线即可轻松充满，单次充电可续航18-24天。设备外观有正常放于冰箱搁板留下的极其轻微细小摩擦痕迹，完全不影响功能。因本人家里养猫，出海鲜市场前已使用医用酒精湿巾对机身外部进行了全方位擦拭消毒与气吹清灰，介意猫咪气味的小伙伴请留意。
